title: High Molecular Weight DNA Extraction for Long Read Sequencing
author: Karen Cristine Goncalves dos Santos
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.uppevmn

steps.title: Prepare lysis buffer
steps.instruction: Mix 5 mL Buffer A (2.5 vol), 5 mL Buffer B (2.5 vol), 2 mL Buffer C (1.0 vol), 1 mL 10 % PVP‑40 and 1 mL 10 % PVP‑10 in a container to obtain the lysis buffer.

steps.title: Grind tissue with liquid nitrogen
steps.instruction: Place 100 mg fungal tissue/spores in a mortar with sand (1 g sand per 100 mg material). Add liquid nitrogen, grind for 2 min in four 15‑second bursts, adding liquid nitrogen after each burst. Scrape mycelia and spores from two fully covered 90 mm petri dishes using a sharp scalpel.

steps.title: Lyse cells in lysis buffer
steps.instruction: Transfer the ground tissue‑sand mixture to a 50 mL Falcon tube containing the prepared lysis buffer. Add 10 µL RNase A and 100 µL Proteinase K, invert until no clumps are visible, then incubate on a rotator at 30 rpm for 30 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Cool lysate on ice
steps.instruction: Place the tube on ice for 5 min.

steps.title: Precipitate proteins with potassium acetate
steps.instruction: Add 2.8 mL of 5 M potassium acetate (0.2 vol), invert to mix, and incubate on ice for up to 5 min.

steps.title: Centrifuge to pellet debris
steps.instruction: Spin at 4 °C, 5000 g for 12 min.

steps.title: Transfer supernatant
steps.instruction: Carefully transfer the aqueous supernatant (avoid phenol phase) to a fresh Falcon tube, taking as much as possible.

steps.title: First phenol‑chloroform extraction
steps.instruction: Add 17 mL (~1 vol) phenol:chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (P:C:I) to the supernatant, invert to mix.

steps.title: RNase treatment post‑extraction
steps.instruction: Transfer the aqueous phase to a new 50 mL Falcon tube, add 10 µL RNase A, and incubate on a rotator at 30 rpm for 30 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Add sodium acetate
steps.instruction: Transfer the tube to a new 50 mL Falcon tube and add 0.1 vol (~1.5 mL) sodium acetate, then invert to mix.

steps.title: Isopropanol precipitation
steps.instruction: Add 1 vol (~17 mL) cold isopropanol, mix well by inversion.

steps.title: Pellet DNA
steps.instruction: Spin at 4 °C, 8000 g for 30 min.

steps.title: Resuspend pellet in residual supernatant
steps.instruction: Pour off supernatant leaving ~1 mL, use this liquid to dislodge the DNA pellet and transfer the mixture to a 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Collect pellet
steps.instruction: Spin the 1.5 mL tube at 15 000 g for 3 min.

steps.title: First ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Discard supernatant, add 1 mL cold 70 % ethanol, flick to wash the pellet, then spin at 15 000 g for 3 min.

steps.title: Remove residual ethanol
steps.instruction: Discard the ethanol, spin briefly to collect remaining liquid, then air‑dry the pellet for 1 min.

steps.title: Resuspend DNA in Tris
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL 10 mM Tris, pH 8.5, flick to dislodge the pellet and let dissolve overnight. Measure concentration with a Qubit fluorometer and absorbance with a Nanodrop.

steps.title: Bind DNA to AMPure beads
steps.instruction: Vortex AMPure beads, add 0.6 vol of beads to the DNA solution, mix by flick (do NOT vortex), and incubate on a rotator at 30 rpm for 10 min.

steps.title: First magnetic separation
steps.instruction: Spin the bead/DNA mixture for 1‑2 sec, place on a magnetic rack, wait for beads to collect, then pipette off the supernatant.

steps.title: Remove ethanol from beads
steps.instruction: Remove the tube from the magnet, spin 1‑2 sec, place back on the magnet, let the bead pellet stabilize, then pipette off remaining ethanol (do NOT let ethanol dry).

steps.title: Elute DNA from beads
steps.instruction: Add 49 µL nuclease‑free water, flick to resuspend, and incubate at 37 °C for 5 min.

steps.title: Proteinase K treatment of eluate
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL Proteinase K and incubate on a rotator at 30 rpm for 30 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Final bead cleanup and quantification
steps.instruction: Spin briefly, place on the magnetic rack, wait for beads to pellet, recover the supernatant, and measure DNA concentration with Qubit and Nanodrop.

steps.title: Wash beads with cold 70 % ethanol
steps.instruction: Add enough cold 70 % ethanol to fill the tube, pipette the ethanol against the tube wall opposite the bead pellet, then remove the ethanol as described above.

steps.title: Second phenol‑chloroform extraction
steps.instruction: Add 1 vol (≈17 mL) phenol:chloroform:isoamyl alcohol, invert to mix, and spin at 4 °C, 5000 g for 12 min.
